completion_data.completion_summary: The stability condition (C5) StabFaithful is now stated natively over PlusFormula.stab on the branching witness frame, decided by a bounded window scan, consumed by the seventh case of the L-plus agreement theorem, and carried as one of six checked components of PlusCertifies. Gate C33 is green: FormalSystem.lean is byte-for-byte the generated root at 603 imports, covering the 16 modules three tasks had left unregistered.

metadata.build_guard_defect: lake-build-guard.sh replayed a stale result across a differently-scoped build and reported success while writing no .olean for the requested module. Every build in this dispatch used --no-share as a workaround. The scope key appears not to distinguish `build` from `build Module.Name`.
